reading.text:
UNIT def:LevyStochCalc.Driver.LevyDriver.mk -- reading (locked before any Lean)

The constructor of LevyDriver. Its meaning is that of the structure's fields and constraints
(see the LevyDriver reading: d-dim BM, Poisson random measure with intensity dt x nu with nu
sigma-finite, independence of W, N, F_0, filtration the usual augmentation of the generated
filtration). Faithful iff the structure is faithful.

Paper context (sec. 2, sec. 3, sec. 4, App. A). Standing basis: (Omega,F,(F_t),P) satisfying the usual
conditions, horizon T>0, d-dimensional Brownian motion W and an independent Poisson random
measure N on R_+ x E with intensity dt nu(de), nu sigma-finite on a countably generated (E,E);
(F_t) is the usual augmentation of the filtration generated by W, N and an independent initial
sigma-field F_0. Stochastic integrals int Z dW (Z in H^2_W: R^{m x d}-valued predictable,
E int_0^T |Z|_F^2 dt < oo) and int int U dNtilde (U in H^2_N) are the L^2 (Ito /
compensated-Poisson isometry) integrals; they are true L^2 martingales, cadlag, and are used in
identities holding a.s. for every t (sec. 3, "solution"). The paper never constructs these
integrals itself: it takes the standard construction (Applebaum sec. 4, He-Wang-Yan). So every
unit below is infrastructure: the paper's notion is the textbook one, and a faithful Lean
definition is one that (together with the other definitions) yields the textbook object on the
paper's basis for every integrand the paper's claims use; junk values outside that class are
harmless only if every proposition restricts to the class.

comparison.text:
Comparison: def:LevyStochCalc.Driver.LevyDriver.mk (constructor)

Reading: the constructor means what the structure means. Lean: mk takes W : MultidimBrownianMotion
P d, N : PoissonRandomMeasure P nu and Indep (sup_i sigmaBrownian (W.W i)) (sigmaPoisson N) P,
returning LevyDriver P d nu (nu sigma-finite). Exactly the structure's content (unit LevyDriver):
W, N, independence; F_0, the augmented filtration, countable generation of E and d >= 1 are
supplied by consumers.
Verdict: faithful with representation choices.

verdict.detail:
Same choices as the structure LevyDriver: F_0 (with its independence from sigma(W, N)), the
paper's augmented filtration (enlJoint), countable generation of E and d >= 1 are supplied by the
consumers, not by the constructor; with them, the constructor's data are exactly the paper's
standing basis.

author_review.disagreements:
No disagreement on substance; labelling. The reviewer records "faithful" for the constructor while
recording "faithful with representation choices" for the structure LevyDriver whose fields it
takes. I gave the constructor the structure's label, since its meaning is the structure's (F_0,
the augmented filtration, countable generation of E and d >= 1 supplied by consumers). Either
label carries the same content.
